scope: Only in-page navigation fallback for the existing content, homepage and career links. Four Adalar content payloads, metadata and their completed CMS review remain unchanged.
finding: Live production query disappeared when the comparison link was clicked before hydration. After hydration the existing router link preserved it. An exported absolute path cannot include a future visitor query.
change: InPageLink emits a native fragment-only href and uses React Router useLinkClickHandler after mount, retaining current search and router scroll restoration. Modified and caller-cancelled clicks keep native semantics.
contentReview: No textual, image, model, route, business-fact or other-brand content changes in this delta. Prior originality/provenance/local evidence remains historical and intact.
limitations: Final-head CI and live post-deployment acceptance are separate gates.
Code event classification still does not prove GA4 receipt.
Search Console remains blocked on authenticated account authorization.
